description: Get the company tracking domain every sending domain uses for tracked links and opens: hostname, status, whether links use it now (active), the CNAME record to publish, and the last check. trackingDomain is null when none is set and links use the shared Sequenzy domain.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

name: get_tracking_domain

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `get_tracking_domain` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

trackingDomain.description: Company tracking domain {domain, status, active, everVerified, sslStatus, verifiedAt, lastCheckedAt, error, cnameRecord}, or null when links use the shared Sequenzy tracking domain. active is true once it verifies and links use it.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
